svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four layers of 50 foam, each a strip 216 wide (inside the cover).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut both long edges of every strip at the flare angle, then stack

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so each layer sits 31 further outboard than the one below.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No glue: the cover and the straps hold the layers together.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Not polystyrene (fuel dissolves it); not open-cell foam.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: stack fits the cover with no gap at the corners.
